title: What If ITER Reached Full Fusion Operation?
description:
If we built a star on Earth, what would it cost, and what would it prove?

Sources:
- U.S. Department of Energy Office of Science: https://science.osti.gov/
- NASA Science: https://science.nasa.gov/
- NIST: https://www.nist.gov/topics/physics

Illustrative visuals are labelled. Speculative outcomes are not presented as measured fact.

Impossible Brief · Episode 14 · One impossible scenario, worked through with real science, every day.
